npcs.title: Sersil Tangleroot
npcs.name: Picture showing old alpha location
npcs.location: Across from the Fungi Lift
npcs.description: Just some cult member preaching about the Seven Courts or whatever. * Conversation You say, "Hail, Sersil Tangleroot." : Sersil Tangleroot beams a wide smile in your direction. : Sersil Tangleroot says, "There is wisdom in the tenets of the Fae Realm! Will you hear their message, traveler?" You say, "Message?" : Sersil Tangleroot spreads his arms in a gesture that encompasses everything around him. : Sersil Tangleroot says, "All of Evershade Weald would not be as it is without the benevolence of our fae benefactors. It was not through the grace of any gods that our forest has thrived over the course of many cataclysms." : Sersil Tangleroot says, "It is only through the intervention of the Fae Realm that we survived here at all, so why should we imprison ourselves in a world which has so often sought to cast us out?" : Sersil Tangleroot says, "We Faelewyn should disassociate ourselves with the other races of this land, and embrace the teachings and comforts of the Seven Courts. Only then can our people finally be at peace." : Sersil Tangleroot says, "Spread this message to any kind who would hear it, so that they too can revel in the wisdom of learning from the fae." You say, "Seven Courts?" : Sersil Tangleroot widens his smile at you, encouraged by the show of curiosity. : Sersil Tangleroot says, "I am but a herald of the Servants of the Seven Courts. Many here would call us a cult, but we are mere worshippers of those who have shown to be our true deities." : Sersil Tangleroot says, "Anyone can witness with their own eyes the grace that the Fae and their rulers have gifted upon this land. Thus our faith belongs to them, and only them." You say, "Cult?" : Sersil Tangleroot chuckles lightly and shakes his head. : Sersil Tangleroot says, "We are no more a cult than any church who offers their faith to a higher being. Is it a crime to simply wish to return to the true home in which we belong? : Sersil Tangleroot says, "From the moment our people took shelter within the Fae Realms, Aethoril was no longer our home." : Sersil Tangleroot says, "We returned to these lands as strangers and were greeted by hostility and contempt." : Sersil Tangleroot says, "That is why the Faelewyn people should leave this world behind, to take up our rightful place alongside the Fae. A people and a world which embrace and welcome us openly." : Sersil Tangleroot says, "Don't you agree?" You say, "No?" : Sersil Tangleroot offers you a small bow of his head, the man's ever-present smile not faltering. : Sersil Tangleroot says, "I wish you no ill will in that case, my friend. It is only a matter of time before the tenets of the Fae are heeded by all within Evershade." : Sersil Tangleroot says, "Until such time, I bid you safe travels."

npcs.description: Weapon Merchant You say, "Hail, Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir." Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir says, "Ah, a customer... or just a curious wanderer?" Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir leans in to speak candidly. Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir says, "Listen, I'm not here for idle chit-chat. If you've got coin, we can make a deal. If not, best move along before there's trouble. The bazaar is not as safe as it seems." Weaponsmith Sielah Zefir says, "If you're looking for something in particular, name it and I'll see if I have it in my private stock."

Especially fond of halfling and gnome blood.
